units: <cite ref="Shabbat 92b:12">Sabb. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>שנים … בק׳ כותבין</he> if two take hold … of a pen and write; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:12">Tosef. ib. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:10">X</cite>), 10; Sifra Vayiḳra, Ḥob., ch. IX, Par. 7.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:3">Sabb. I, 3</cite> <he>בקוֹלְמוֹסוֹ</he>; Y. ib. 3ᵇ, v. <cite ref="L00092"><he>לִבְלָר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Taanit 20b:3">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>לפיכך זכה קנה … ק׳ וכ׳</he> therefore (because of its yielding nature) the reed was privileged to supply the pen with which to write the Torah &c. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 37 <he>עד שמשה … נשתייר בק׳ וכ׳</he> when Moses wrote the Torah, something (of the fire-ink) was left in the pen, and he passed it over his head &c.

<cite ref="Pesachim 118b:16">Pes. 118ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 68:31">Ps. LXVIII, 31</cite>) <he>געור בחיה … בק׳ אחד</he> rebuke the beast (Rome) all of whose deeds are written down with the same pen (of tyranny); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 30b:3">Ḥull. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>שחיטה העשויה כק׳</he> a cut (of the animal’s throat) shaped like the cut of a writing reed (slanting).—Pl. <he>קוֹלְמוֹסִים</he>, <he>קוֹלְמוֹסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 12:3:2">Y. Sabb. XII, 13ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כמין ק׳ היו עשויין</he> the boards were cut like pens (thinner and slanting on top).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 58:8">Gen. R. s. 58</cite>, a. e. <he>כמה ק׳ משתברין</he> how many pens were broken &c., v. <cite ref="D00500"><he>דְּיוֹ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 7:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. VII, 12</cite> <he>הק׳</he> metal pens (styluses; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:8">Kel. XII, 8</cite> sing.).

<cite ref="Shabbat 11a:5">Sabb. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>אם יהיו … ואנמים ק׳ וכ׳</he> if all seas were ink, and all reeds pens &c.; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 25:3">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXV</cite> <he>קלְמוֹסִים</he> (ed. Schechter <he>קול׳</he>, Var. <he>קוּלְמְסִין</he>).
